assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square seamless repeating wall albedo texture for Depths, a dark first-person dungeon crawler with simple shadow-heavy pixel environments. Primary request: WORKED CAVE wall, geological warm charcoal-grey fractured rock with broad irregular shale slabs and a few subdued old pick scars. Fill the entire square with the surface, viewed dead straight-on in flat orthographic projection, no room perspective or objects. Style: deliberately restrained low-resolution pixel-art game texture, broad clustered shapes, about 16 material colours, sparse small chips, 128 by 128 native-pixel design enlarged cleanly; readable in a dim phone game at 64 pixels. Big irregular interlocking slabs, subtle depth, short dark crevices. Flat neutral diffuse lighting across the entire image, medium-dark albedo so in-game torch light can reveal it; no baked directional light, vignettes or corner shadows. Material edges must wrap seamlessly on all four sides in a repeated wall. No central focal motif, no border, no atlas, no labels, no writing, symbols, ore rewards, props, torches or characters. Avoid photorealism, noisy granular detail, dense scratch texture, smooth 3D render and painted illumination. One opaque square texture only.

Substantial roughly cut stones, shallow chips, restrained roughness. This must read as an occupied, patched fortification without a timber frame or giant repeating emblem.
